name: Protect the Frontier
summary: At Elwynn's eastern bridge, Guard Thomas asks you to thin the wolves and bears threatening travelers and workers near Eastvale Logging Camp. The beasts have grown bold, putting roads and logging crews at risk.

sections.title: A Thinning Defense
sections.body: Goldshire and Northshire Valley have visible Stormwind garrisons. The eastern frontier has far fewer guards. Guard Thomas watches the river crossing, one of the few sentries between the settled heartlands and the wilderness. Travelers help keep the supply roads open.

sections.title: The Predatory Threat
sections.body: Eastvale Logging Camp sends timber to Stormwind City. Woodsmen cutting trees at the forest's edge face prowlers, gray forest wolves, and young forest bears near the roads and lumber yards. Culling the beasts eases the danger to local workers for a time. Thomas suspects something deeper in the woods is driving them toward settlements.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Protect the Frontier?
faq.answer: Guard Thomas gives the order. He watches the eastern bridge on Elwynn Forest's main road, between the forest interior and the Eastvale region.

faq.q: Why are wolves and bears attacking the frontier?
faq.answer: Wolves and bears press near roads and work sites around Eastvale Logging Camp. Thomas suspects something deeper in the wilderness is agitating them and driving them toward settled ground.

faq.q: Where is the Eastvale Logging Camp?
faq.answer: Eastvale Logging Camp lies in eastern Elwynn Forest, just east of Guard Thomas's bridge. It supplies vital lumber to Stormwind and border settlements.

faq.q: Why is Guard Thomas watching the bridge alone?
faq.answer: Stormwind's army and city guard are stretched thin across the kingdom. River and crossroads outposts often have only one or two guards watching the highways, so they rely on travelers to handle large wildlife threats.

faq.q: What animals need to be culled for this task?
aliases: what mobs for protect the frontier
faq.answer: You need to slay eight wolves, either prowlers or gray forest wolves, and five young forest bears roaming eastern Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: What happens once the wildlife is culled?
faq.answer: When you report back, Guard Thomas thanks you, and logging caravans can travel more safely. He remains wary that the dark influence stirring the beasts may bring further trouble to the forest.

angles.text: Keeping the eastern roads secure helps Eastvale's lumber reach Alliance lands, where it supports reconstruction and defense.
As a hunter, you can test your tracking and marksmanship against the wolves and bears stalking eastern Elwynn Forest.
